tool.name: Codestral 22B
tool.summary: Mistral AI's code generation model tailored for fill-in-the-middle (FIM), code completion, unit test drafting, and repository navigation across 80+ languages.
tool.architecture: Dense autoregressive model with 32k context and bidirectional FIM tokens.
tool.usage:
from mistralai import Mistral
client = Mistral(api_key="API_KEY")
response = client.fim.complete(
  model="codestral-latest",
  prompt="def calculate_fibonacci(n):",
  suffix="return result"
)
tool.limitations: Non-commercial license for direct weights use unless licensed via Mistral API.
